title: Happy Wallet | Executive Overview
description: Operational business KPIs derived from observability telemetry. These values provide near-real-time operational visibility and are not system-of-record financial reporting.

panels.title: Successful Logins
panels.description: Estimated counter increase in the selected dashboard range; fractional values are expected from Prometheus extrapolation. A newly observed counter's first increment may not be measurable. Missing outcome series are treated as zero only when attempt counter growth can be evaluated; absent/insufficient metric data stays unavailable. Each successful login retry counts again; this is not a unique-user count.

panels.title: Failed Logins
panels.description: Estimated counter increase in the selected dashboard range; fractional values are expected from Prometheus extrapolation. A newly observed counter's first increment may not be measurable. Missing outcome series are treated as zero only when attempt counter growth can be evaluated; absent/insufficient metric data stays unavailable. Each failed login retry counts again.

panels.title: Login Success Rate
panels.description: Successful login outcomes divided by successful plus failed login outcomes in the selected range. Retries count as separate outcomes. No observed outcomes is distinct from 0% success; missing/insufficient samples show No metric data.

targets.expr: clamp_max((100 * (sum(increase(banking_login_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_login_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) / (((sum(increase(banking_login_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_login_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) + (sum(increase(banking_login_failure_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_login_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range]))))) > 0)), 100) or (vector(-1) and on() (((sum(increase(banking_login_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_login_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) + (sum(increase(banking_login_failure_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_login_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range]))))) == 0))

panels.title: Successful Transfer Executions
panels.description: Estimated counter increase in the selected dashboard range; fractional values are expected from Prometheus extrapolation. A newly observed counter's first increment may not be measurable. Missing outcome series are treated as zero only when attempt counter growth can be evaluated; absent/insufficient metric data stays unavailable. Uses backend outcome counters: recognized idempotent replays do not add successful executions. This is an operational estimate, not a ledger count.

panels.title: Failed Transfer Executions
panels.description: Estimated counter increase in the selected dashboard range; fractional values are expected from Prometheus extrapolation. A newly observed counter's first increment may not be measurable. Missing outcome series are treated as zero only when attempt counter growth can be evaluated; absent/insufficient metric data stays unavailable. Recognized idempotent replays are excluded. Unrecognized/pre-persistence retry failures may count again; failed validations and stored insufficient-funds rejections count. Recipient lookups are excluded.

panels.title: Transfer Success Rate
panels.description: Successful non-replay transfer outcomes divided by successful plus failed non-replay transfer outcomes in the selected range, not payment attempts. Recognized replays are excluded; other retry failures can affect the rate. No observed outcomes and missing metric data have distinct states.

targets.expr: clamp_max((100 * (sum(increase(banking_transfer_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_transfer_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) / (((sum(increase(banking_transfer_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_transfer_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) + (sum(increase(banking_transfer_failure_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_transfer_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range]))))) > 0)), 100) or (vector(-1) and on() (((sum(increase(banking_transfer_success_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_transfer_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])))) + (sum(increase(banking_transfer_failure_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase(banking_transfer_attempts_total{job="synthetic-banking-api"}[$__range]))))) == 0))
